title: Annotation API NEL request
description: JSON body of POST /api/nel/. Either `data` with the NER `entities` to link, or, with no entities, a `data` string where one mention is marked as `[START] mention [END]` (marker form).

data.description: Text to link, or a legacy object holding the text under `sentence`, `text` or `data`.

entities.description: NER mentions to link, as returned by /api/ner/. Mentions without integer `lOffset` and `rOffset` are skipped.

NER seconds.description: Upstream NER time in seconds, echoed back in the response. Frozen wire name containing a space.
